summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a 4.33 million NIS (approx. USD $1.4 million) non-dilutive, zero-interest loan/grant from the Israel Innovation Authority to fund AI-driven plant-cell synthesis R&D. The grant has no equity component and repayment is contingent on future commercial milestones. This is a routine funding disclosure, not a special situation transaction.
